description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax (if applicable).
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chicken Troupe to your hand and returning any stickers on it to your sticker sheet.
Cast Chicken Troupe by paying {1}{G}.
Chicken Troupe enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chicken Troupe trigger, getting {TK} and putting an art sticker onto itself.
Goblin Airbrusher triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {1}{G}.
Repeat.
